title: Hugging Face Launches Agent Manager to Orchestrate Dozens of AI Agents
summary:
Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode can now communicate with each other to execute intricate technical workflows through a synchronized environment. Hugging Face released the Agent Manager tool to enable developers to coordinate dozens of these AI agents across various harnesses, allowing them to self-organize to complete complex tasks. The system is designed to run on HF Spaces to ensure that agent operations and communications continue without interruption.

The software focuses on the industry shift from single-model interactions toward autonomous multi-agent systems. By providing a centralized layer for orchestration, Hugging Face allows users to automate processes that would typically require manual coordination between different specialized AI frameworks.
